name: verifix
description: Evidence-verified AI code repair: generate, verify, diagnose, repair.

verifix.command.description: Command used to launch the Verifix CLI.

verifix.projectDir.description: Directory of the Verifix Python project (where `uv run verifix` works). Auto-detected upward from the workspace if empty.

verifix.fakePatches.description: Directory of canned *.diff files (workspace-relative or absolute) for the fake agent.

verifix.sandbox.description: Where generated code runs: 'container' uses rootless podman/docker with no network (slower first run: builds an image).

verifix.confirmInterpretation.description: For typed or GitHub issues, show how Verifix understood the issue and ask for confirmation before running.

scripts.test: node test/apply_patch.test.js && node test/webview.test.js && node test/understand.test.js
